Product Marketing turns Chainalysis innovation into customer value. We position our intelligence as solutions customers can understand and consume through our platform, shape how we commercialize them, and give GTM the stories and strategic assets to win.

The public sector is a priority growth segment for Chainalysis, spanning law enforcement, intelligence agencies, regulators and tax authorities. As digital assets become more integrated into the financial system, these organizations need the intelligence, tools and tradecraft to advance their missions—from shaping policy and enforcing the rules to disrupting illicit networks and protecting national security. This role connects Chainalysis capabilities to those mission priorities, with a clear, compelling story for agency leaders and operational teams.

As Senior Product Marketing Manager for the Public Sector, you will own how Chainalysis shows up in the market for these buyers. You will shape our intelligence, data, products, AI capabilities, and services into a differentiated customer story—one that connects to real workflows, urgent problems, and mission outcomes.

This is a role for a strong marketer and an exceptional writer. You can take a complex capability, a shifting market, or a fuzzy customer problem and shape it into a sharp point of view, a persuasive narrative, and practical tools that sellers and customers actually use. You will work closely with Product, Sales, Marketing & Communications, subject-matter experts, and GTM Solutions & Readiness teams to make the story land in the market.

In this role, you’ll:

Position the value

  • Define and evolve the public sector value narrative: what Chainalysis enables, why it matters, and why we are meaningfully different.

  • Build messaging for priority buyer and user personas, from agency leaders to investigators, intelligence analysts, regulators and tax specialists.

  • Create the narratives, proof points, and strategic assets that help sellers communicate differentiated value with conviction.

  • Own public-sector competitive intelligence, translating market moves into clear offensive and defensive positioning for deal teams.

Turn value into solutions

  • Partner with Product, R&D, Marketing & Communications, and subject-matter experts to translate innovation into compelling industry solutions, use cases, and sales plays.

  • Lead go-to-market planning for launches, major releases, platform capabilities, and commercial offerings.

  • Shape customer-facing value narratives for pricing, packaging, and usage-based commercial models, including business cases, operational value and mission impact.

  • Bring a customer lens to product and market decisions: explain not only what a capability does, but how it advances the customer’s mission.

Win and learn in market

  • Produce the strategic content that moves government opportunities forward: first-call decks, solution briefs, talk tracks, discovery frameworks, proof points, and sales plays.

  • Partner with Product, Product Marketing, GTM & Enablement teams to scale the strongest narratives into field tools and enablement.

  • Bring customer, field, partner, and competitive insight back into the work — sharpening positioning, converting market evidence into credible stories, and building repeatable use cases.

We’re looking for candidates who have:

  • 5–8 years in product, solutions, industry, or B2B enterprise technology marketing, with experience marketing to public-sector customers across law enforcement, intelligence, regulatory or tax functions.

  • A demonstrated ability to build positioning and messaging that changes how customers and sellers see a problem—not simply content that fills a library.

  • Exceptional writing and editorial judgment. You can write crisp headlines, persuasive narratives, practical sales content, and executive-level messaging; you know the difference between jargon and precision.

  • Strong understanding of public-sector buying journeys, decision-making processes and mission-oriented sales motions.

  • The ability to connect technical capabilities to mission and operational value for both executive buyers and hands-on users.

  • A collaborative self-starter, comfortable working across R&D, Sales, technical and revenue teams, and senior leaders to drive ambiguous, multi-stakeholder work forward independently.

Nice to have experience:

  • Experience with blockchain, digital assets, or crypto-native financial infrastructure.

  • Experience marketing AI-powered products, data platforms, intelligence products, cybersecurity, or risk and compliance technology.

  • Familiarity with consumption- or usage-based pricing and packaging.

  • Familiarity with investigative, intelligence, national-security, regulatory or tax use cases for intelligence and technology, and the policy developments shaping digital-asset markets.

You’ll thrive here if:

You can shape complexity into a story people remember and a sales conversation people can use. You write with precision, bring sound judgment to ambiguous problems, build for repeatability rather than one-off requests, and care about the quality of what reaches customers and the field.

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.
descriptions.job-1ltnghe:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Dashboard Product team is committed to providing world-class user experiences for Stripe merchants. We focus on perfecting the Dashboard Stripe’s main interface for merchants - by infusing meticulous attention to detail and craft. We take immense pride in our work and deeply care about the quality of the products we deliver. We’re dedicated to building a team with an acute focus on detail, nurturing a level of craftsmanship that makes us proud to share our work with the world.

We serve two core user groups. First, is real merchants using the Dashboard. We own the most critical, first-touch surfaces, such as the homepage, which we drive to set the benchmark for intuitive, reliable software. This work directly informs our second set of users, internal product teams. We distill our front-line insights into shared components and paradigms, empowering the entire organization to build a consistent, holistic Dashboard experience.

We're a mentorship-forward team where staff engineers work directly alongside early-career engineers to raise the quality bar across everything we ship. We're also actively exploring how AI agents can unlock new creative possibilities for how merchants interact with their products, and we're excited to bring that same spirit of invention to the frontend craft.

What you'll do

As a Frontend Engineer on the Dashboard Product team, you’ll collaborate with skilled designers and engineers to drive UX excellence in the Stripe Dashboard. You’ll craft experiences that simplify complex tasks for merchants, ensuring high performance, seamless information architecture, and intuitive discoverability. You’ll work on inventing new paradigms and elevating existing ones, with an eye toward broader use cases on the Dashboard. Working closely with designers and cross-functional groups, you’ll craft experiences that help merchants understand their business and execute essential tasks with surprising levels of ease and delight.

You’ll also mentor early-career engineers to raise our collective quality bar, all while exploring how emerging AI agents can unlock new, creative ways for merchants to interact with their business.

Responsibilities

  • Own the frontend quality, consistency, and visual craft of the Stripe Dashboard's highest-traffic pages, with particular focus on core logged-in surfaces
  • Identify and execute opportunities to improve consistency, performance, and polish across the Dashboard
  • Partner closely with Design and Product,, serving as the technical voice on frontend feasibility, quality standards, and implementation approach
  • Contribute to and advocate for the Stripe design system, ensuring components and patterns work well across the Dashboard and other product surfaces
  • Establish frontend quality standards for the team, including patterns, code review practices, and implementation guidance for junior engineers
  • Prototype and explore AI-powered experiences that change how merchants discover and interact with Stripe products
  • Collaborate with backend engineers on integration points while keeping frontend craft as your core focus

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • This is a Staff-level role - that typically means 10+ years of experience building and shipping complex, user-facing web applications at large scale
  • Deep expertise in modern frontend development, with strong opinions on UI quality and the ability to execute to a high level of visual precision
  • Track record of driving measurable improvements to UI consistency and polish across large, distributed products
  • Experience working closely with Design teams and translating design intent into high-quality production implementation
  • Demonstrated ability to work across a large codebase and bring coherence to high-traffic product surfaces

Preferred qualifications

  • Passion for crafting beautiful experiences on the web, demonstrated through a design portfolio and frontend code showcasing engaging microsites, Figma plugins, creative code, design systems, or other similar endeavors
  • Familiarity with frontend performance engineering, including profiling, instrumentation, and optimization
  • Interest in AI-driven user experiences, with experience prototyping or shipping AI-powered features
  • Experience mentoring early-career engineers and contributing to team-wide quality standards
  • Comfort working across the full stack when needed, with a clear preference and passion for frontend craft
  • Advanced proficiency with React, with an emphasis on interactions, animation, performance, and refinement
  • Experience with A/B testing, synthetic monitoring, or accessibility testing

Reports to:

Chief Compliance Officer, US Regulated Entities

Position Overview
We are seeking a BSA/AML Officer with deep Blockchain Compliance expertise to play a key role in the business expansion of our regulated US digital currency trading business. In this role, you will support the spot, derivative, and tokenized securities business lines in the US, encompassing the MTL businesses (spot), FCM, and Broker Dealer entities. As the BSA/AML Officer, you will be responsible for our BSA/AML & OFAC Sanctions programs and ensuring that we maintain compliance with all applicable local, US, and international laws and regulations impacting the digital currency industry. You will also bring specialized knowledge of blockchain structures, networks, and on-chain activities to help our U.S. businesses develop and implement appropriate processes and controls supporting spot trading, derivatives, and tokenized securities activities..

This position is based in NYC and will be required to work from our NYC office. The role reports to the US Chief Compliance Officer.


Responsibilities:


BSA/AML & Sanctions Oversight

  • Lead the compliance program for tokenized securities, derivatives, and spot crypto trading to meet all applicable state and federal regulatory requirements and reflect the nature of a rapidly changing risk landscape, including:
    • BSA/AML compliance;
    • Sanctions compliance;
    • fraud risk;
    • market integrity;
    • Compliance with state licensing requirements;
  • Implement the domestic BSA/AML and OFAC compliance programs in line with U.S. regulatory requirements.
  • Maintain risk-based BSA/AML and OFAC policies and procedures addressing all areas of BSA/AML and OFAC; advise Bullish staff and management of deficiencies and ensure that required changes are made.
  • Direct the domestic BSA/AML and OFAC compliance monitoring program to ensure there are sufficient internal controls to promote an effective control environment.
  • Coordinate with offshore affiliates and exercise oversight to ensure any controls performed on behalf of the U.S. entity by the affiliates are performed to a standard that meets U.S. requirements.
  • Oversee regulatory reporting to FinCEN, SEC, CFTC, FINRA, NFA, NYDFS, and other federal and state regulators, as necessary, to comply with Bullish’s BSA/AML reporting obligations, including ensuring the timely filing of suspicious activity reports (“SARs”).
  • Prepare monthly and quarterly management reporting of BSA/AML-related metrics.
  • Identify, escalate, track, and remediate, as necessary, BSA/AML compliance-related issues.
  • Perform BSA/AML, CIP, and OFAC risk assessments as needed and work with stakeholders and various forms of data to inform, update, streamline and optimize the BSA/AML and OFAC program.
  • Lead the process for ensuring all BSA/AML and OFAC reports are filed as required and all BSA/AML and OFAC related records are maintained according to regulatory requirements.
  • Contribute to building a compliance culture across the firm by training Bullish employees on key policies, procedures, and their responsibilities in preventing financial crime.

Blockchain Intelligence & Tokenization Compliance

  • Act as the lead compliance investigator and subject-matter specialist for blockchain analytics, wallet clustering, and transaction tracing across spot trading, derivatives margin/settlement, and tokenized assets.
  • Conduct hands-on forensic investigations into flagged deposit and withdrawal addresses using enterprise blockchain tools (e.g., Chainalysis, TRM Labs, Elliptic), tracing funds through bridges, decentralized protocols, and mixing services.
  • Play a key role in building Bullish’s U.S. tokenized securities business, working with Legal, Product, and Engineering to develop processes and controls for on-chain trading, custody, settlement, and transfer activities.
  • Apply expertise in blockchain networks, smart contracts, and tokenization structures to design and implement controls that address emerging risks and evolving industry practices and regulatory requirements.
  • Develop and maintain compliance controls for tokenized securities, including wallet whitelisting, investor eligibility verification, transfer restrictions, and on-chain transaction monitoring.
  • Assess proposed token listings, blockchain networks, smart contract upgrades, and bridge mechanisms for financial crime, sanctions, and other compliance risks.
  • Translate on-chain transaction activity and smart contract data into actionable findings to support suspicious activity investigations, regulatory reporting, and law enforcement requests.

Experience & Qualifications:

  • Sufficient experience in one or a combination of the following to satisfy the requirements to be appointed into the role: financial crime, Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), Anti-Money Laundering (AML), financial crime investigations, and/or risk management, audit, compliance, specifically with exposure to digital assets.
  • Experience in managing regulatory examinations and relationships with examiners (e.g., NYDFS, FINRA, NFA, SEC, CFTC), auditors, and banking partners.
  • Extensive knowledge of the Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), USA PATRIOT Act, OFAC regulations, as well as SEC, CFTC, FINRA, and NFA rules and requirements.
  • Awareness of regulatory requirements including local and US laws, international and industry standards.
  • Demonstrated proficiency using enterprise blockchain forensics platforms (e.g., Chainalysis Reactor/KYT, TRM Labs, Elliptic Forensics) to trace complex transaction paths and produce investigative summaries.
  • Working knowledge of smart contract mechanics, token standards (e.g., ERC-20, ERC-1400, ERC-3643), permissioned wallet registries, and the ability to assess the impact of U.S. and international securities laws on on-chain trade execution, settlement, custody, and regulatory reporting.
  • Strong attention to detail and strong organizational, problem solving, analytical, and management skills.
  • Ability to execute in a fast paced, high demand environment while managing multiple priorities.
  • Bachelor’s Degree/University degree or equivalent experience; Advanced degree (e.g. JD, MBA, etc.) preferred.
  • Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS), Certified Fraud Examiner (CFE), Certified Regulatory Compliance Manager (CRCM), Certified Financial Crime Specialist (CFCS) and/or related professional certification preferred.

Bullish US LLC & CoinDesk Inc. are committed to offering competitive compensation and benefits. The anticipated base salary for this position is $175,000 - $215,000 + discretionary annual target bonus + performance incentives/benefits. Offered salary will be reflective of job related knowledge, skills and commensurate experience.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

In an effort to attract, retain, develop and promote the most qualified individuals, CoinDesk is committed to treating all applicants and employees in a nondiscriminatory manner with respect to the terms and conditions of employment, without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, national or ethnic origin, ancestry, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status/service, physical or mental disability, or any other classification protected by applicable law. This mandate governs all aspects of employment, including recruitment, selection, promotion, training, education, social and recreation programs, compensation, discipline, termination and access to benefits.

ACCOMMODATION

CoinDesk is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation because of a disability for any part of the application process, please send an e-mail to recruiting@coindesk.com and let us know the nature of your request.

About Polymarket

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform. We enable individuals to express views on real-world events by trading on outcomes across politics, economics, sports, culture, and current affairs. Built as a peer-to-peer marketplace with no centralized "house," Polymarket aggregates diverse opinions into transparent, market-based probabilities that reflect collective expectations about the future.

We're growing fast, both in terms of volume ($21B traded in 2025) and adoption as an alternative news source. Our ambition is to become a ubiquitous beacon of truth in global media and we need your help adding fuel to the fire.

About the Role

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market, and sports is one of our biggest categories. The marketing team is small and moves fast. We don't have a big agency on retainer or a traditional campaign calendar. What we have is a platform that sits at the intersection of sports, news, and money, and a mandate to make the world aware of it in ways that actually stick.

This role exists because guerilla and stunt marketing is one of the highest-leverage things we can do, and we need a dedicated person who owns it end to end. You'll be the one watching the game, spotting the moment, and showing up with something that earns press and goes viral, not because it was planned six months out, but because you moved faster than everyone else. The person who held this role before built a real playbook here. Your job is to run it, expand it, and make it yours.

This is a high-ownership, high-visibility role. You'll work closely with the marketing lead and have real autonomy, but you'll also be expected to operate independently in the field, often on short notice. If you need a lot of structure or sign-off to act, this isn't the right fit. If you thrive on finding the moment and executing before it passes, keep reading.

What You'll Do

  • Identify stunt and activation concepts tied to live sports moments, news cycles, and cultural events, then pitch them fast with a clear point of view on why they'll land

  • Execute on-the-ground activations at stadiums, arenas, sports bars, and public venues, handling logistics, talent, materials, and timing yourself

  • Monitor social media and sports news in real time to spot openings for reactive content or physical activations before the moment passes

  • Coordinate all logistics for guerilla campaigns from concept through execution, including permits, vendors, travel, and on-site management

  • Build and maintain a pipeline of stunt ideas across the major sports calendar so the team is never starting from zero

  • Track campaign performance after each activation, pulling together data on reach, press pickups, social engagement, and earned media to inform what comes next

  • Represent Polymarket in the field in a way that reflects the brand, sharp, credible, and worth paying attention to

What We're Looking For

  • 5 or more years of experience in guerilla marketing, experiential marketing, or stunt-based brand work, with specific examples of campaigns you personally executed

  • A real track record of viral moments, not just campaigns that got approved, but things that actually spread and earned press coverage

  • High sports IQ across major American leagues, NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, and college sports, with enough fluency to know which moments matter and why

  • Demonstrated ability to execute independently in the field, you've shown up somewhere with a plan and made it happen without a team of ten behind you

  • Comfort operating on short timelines, some of the best opportunities here will have a 24 to 48 hour window

  • (Plus) Existing relationships with sports journalists, beat reporters, or media personalities who cover games and culture

  • (Plus) Experience at a sports betting, DFS, or prediction market brand

  • (Plus) Familiarity with crypto or web3 environments and audiences

Benefits

  • Competitive salary & equity

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Full Health, Vision, & Dental coverage

  • 401k match

  • Hardware setup: new MacBook Pro, big display, & accessories

Reports to: Head of Marketing

The Role, In One Line

You'll work across growth initiatives, campaign planning, content creation, video, and product marketing — helping Grvt turn complex products into compelling stories that people understand, remember, and want to act on.

As we expand our global presence, we want to move beyond generic marketing playbooks and create campaigns and content that resonate with our audiences across different markets and channels.

descriptions.job-04dlc6q:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. 

The Cashiering team’s mission is to ensure accurate, timely movement of funds across customer brokerage and retirement accounts while delivering a compliant, high-quality client experience. We operate with ethics and precision at the center of everything we do to protect our customers' assets.

Our team works closely with partners in Compliance, Operations, and Technology to streamline cashiering processes. We foster a supportive, collaborative environment where team members work together to solve complex operational challenges! Our collective goal is to build trusted, scalable financial processes that support Robinhood's growth.

As a Cashiering Specialist, you will manage high-volume cashiering workflows—primarily reviewing money movement requests, including ACH, check, wire, and other brokerage transactions—serving as a key operational link between advisors, clients, custodians, and internal partners. In this position, you will serve as quality assurance overview of transactions with high accuracy and efficiency while adhering to strict regulatory requirements including AML, and OFAC review. You will collaborate daily with advisors and internal operations teams to resolve inquiries and transaction discrepancies. Your work directly impacts the customer experience by ensuring that fund movements are completed seamlessly. This role provides an excellent opportunity to expand your knowledge of financial markets and back-office operations!

This role is based in our Westlake, TX or Clearwater, FL office, with in-person attendance expected 5 days per week during the 90-day onboarding period. After onboarding, in-person attendance is expected at least 3 days a week.

Shift Options:

  • 7:30 - 4 PM
  • 8:30 - 5 PM

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. 

What you’ll do

  • Review a high volume of money movement requests efficiently, and in line with internal policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Monitor and manage daily transaction queues to meet strict deadlines and service-level expectations, researching and resolving discrepancies and inquiries from initial intake to final resolution.
  • Safeguard the firm by enforcing AML and OFAC requirements and reviewing transactions for adherence to SOPs.
  • Partner with our clearing firm and internal teams (Operations, Compliance, Technology, Advisor Services) to facilitate transactions, resolve issues, and support collaborative projects across these departments.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and client experience within cashiering operations.

What you bring

  • Strong knowledge of asset movement procedures, workflows, and regulatory considerations, along with a basic understanding of financial markets and the securities industry.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and organization, with the ability to manage multiple priorities at once.
  • Clear, professional communication skills, including excellent data entry, written, and verbal communication, and comfort engaging with clients and advisors over the phone.
  • 1-2 years of experience in financial operations, with an SIE required, (99 preferred) and a proven ability to manage transactional workflows using proprietary financial systems.
  • Committed and dependable in a fast-paced, high-volume environment, bringing a collaborative spirit, steady focus, and genuine care for clients and outcomes.
  • Proactive problem-solving abilities, strong analytical, decision-making, and critical thinking skills, with accountability for results and the ability to adapt quickly to new systems.

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career.
  • Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching.
  • Best-in-class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents.
  • Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds.
  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not.
  • Lifestyle wallet — a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more.
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits.
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + benefits.

Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process.

Applying to Paxos? Our only careers site is paxos.com/careers, and we only recruit via @paxos.com email. Details below.
___

About Paxos

Today’s financial infrastructure is archaic, expensive, inefficient and risky — supporting a system that leaves out more people than it lets in. So we’re rebuilding it.

We’re on a mission to open the world’s financial system to everyone by enabling the instant movement of any asset, any time, in a trustworthy way. For over a decade, we’ve built blockchain infrastructure that tokenizes, custodies, trades and settles assets for the world's leading financial institutions, like PayPal, Venmo, Mastercard, Interactive Brokers and Charles Schwab.

About the team

The Commercial Legal team partners closely with Growth, Product, Finance, and other cross-functional stakeholders to help Paxos execute strategic partnerships and business priorities. From early-stage deal structuring through negotiation and execution, the team provides clear, pragmatic legal guidance that balances risk with business goals. The team’s work spans a wide range of commercial relationships, including institutional clients, financial institutions, and technology partners, and plays a direct role in helping Paxos launch products and expand into new markets.

About the role

As Senior Commercial Counsel, you will partner with business teams to close deals efficiently while protecting Paxos' interests. You will translate legal, commercial, technology, and regulatory considerations into clear, actionable recommendations; create leverage through templates, playbooks, and process improvements that help the business scale; and help stakeholders anticipate issues before they become blockers.

You will also manage a range of in-house commercial, corporate, and other legal matters, which may include drafting and maintaining terms and conditions and negotiating banking and financing documents. This role is expected to evolve as the business grows, so versatility, adaptability, and a willingness to take on new areas of work are critical.

What you’ll do

  • Provide expert legal advice to senior finance and business development professionals on deal structure, risk allocation, approval paths, and practical options, translating legal complexity into clear recommendations that support business decisions.

  • Draft, negotiate, and close complex commercial, SaaS, technology, vendor, licensing, data, and strategic-partnership agreements, managing deals from term sheet through signature.

  • Keep cross-functional stakeholders aligned on priorities, decisions, tradeoffs, and next steps, communicating clearly and proactively throughout each matter.

  • Build and improve scalable contract processes, clause libraries, playbooks, and self-service resources that help the business move faster while maintaining consistent legal standards.

  • Spot patterns across matters, identify root causes, and design sustainable solutions rather than one-off fixes, turning recurring issues into lasting process improvements.

  • Use AI and other technology thoughtfully for legal review, drafting, research, and workflow management, applying appropriate human judgment and safeguards to protect quality, confidentiality, and accuracy.

  • Contribute across broader in-house matters as business needs evolve, taking on new areas of work with flexibility and a willingness to learn.

About you

  • 6-10 years of commercial legal experience in technology transactions, SaaS agreements, corporate law, mergers & acquisitions, funds, and/or finance at a top tier law firm or high growth technology company (preferably a combination of both)

  • Experience leading complex commercial negotiations from initial term sheet through final execution, with sound judgment on when to hold firm and when to compromise

  • Commercial mindset with a deep understanding of practical business issues, and the ability to weigh legal risk against business objectives

  • Experience working cross-functionally on multiple projects under tight deadlines while building strong, trusted client relationships

  • Desire to work in a fast-paced, dynamic, and demanding environment, with comfort handling ambiguity and shifting priorities

  • Excellent written and verbal communication and negotiation skills, including the ability to explain complex legal issues clearly to non-lawyers

  • Efficient and judicious use of appropriate AI tools to improve speed and quality, with sound judgment about when human review is essential

You might also have

  • Experience working on a wide variety of in-house legal matters, including employment issues, stock option plans, and intellectual property, and comfort handling unfamiliar areas of law as business needs arise

  • Experience working in a hyper-growth, tech-focused company, with an understanding of how legal teams can scale processes and support the business through rapid change

  • Strong interest in blockchain technology and its evolving regulatory landscape, with curiosity about how digital assets and tokenization are reshaping financial services

Important Notice for Paxos Applicants
Fraudulent accounts sometimes pose as Paxos recruiters on LinkedIn and other platforms, and fake websites sometimes impersonate our careers site. These scammers attempt to deceive applicants into paying for job opportunities or providing personal financial information.

To verify a legitimate Paxos opportunity:

  • Our only official careers site is paxos.com/careers

  • We only use @paxos.com email addresses

  • We never ask for payment or financial details to apply, interview, or work here

  • For technical roles, we do not perform a coding interview without prior screening by our engineering team

Thanks for your interest in Paxos!

In 2018, Bitvavo launched the first version of its digital assets trading platform, to bridge the gap between traditional currencies and digital assets. By offering transparent fees, a wide range of assets and an easy to use platform, Bitvavo is making the currency of the future accessible for everyone.

In two years' time, Bitvavo has established itself as the market leader in the Netherlands and one of the largest in Europe, with over one million users exchanging tens of billions of digital assets a year.

About the Role

People trust Bitvavo with their money, their digital assets and their personal data. Your job is to make sure that trust is always deserved.

We are seeking a strong Data Protection Officer to drive and continuously develop Bitvavo's data protection program, ensuring compliance with data protection and privacy laws including the GDPR. Reporting to the Head of Legal, you will work closely with multiple business units and products to keep Bitvavo compliant across all areas of data protection, as part of the legal team based in Amsterdam. You will own the business processes and policies covering data access, classification, quality and life cycle management.

This is a senior, hands-on role for someone ready to lead the DPO function independently, comfortable making decisions and engaging directly with regulators and with stakeholders at every level, including our Management Board.

What You'll be Doing

This role requires a broad understanding of data protection law, including knowing when to bring in outside expertise. You will provide independent oversight of Bitvavo's compliance with data protection legislation, with real scope to shape our data strategy.

  • Advise and guide Bitvavo on the policies and standards needed to meet its data protection obligations

  • Engage with data protection authorities, including regular briefings, and maintain accurate records demonstrating GDPR compliance

  • Organise training and awareness activities on data protection and privacy across the company

  • Build a culture that embeds respect for data protection and privacy, acting as the champion for compliance

  • Communicate the privacy implications of new technology and proof of concepts clearly, to both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Assist in addressing mandatory notification and other legal issues in the event of a data loss or breach

  • Challenge the status quo with creative, pragmatic solutions to difficult data protection problems, including on innovative ecommerce and AI projects

  • Devise privacy preserving methods for using large structured, unstructured, transactional and real time data sets, and turn data protection law, statistics and business judgement into actionable recommendations

What We're Looking For

This role requires a qualified lawyer holding a law degree, with at least 7 years of experience in data protection including a minimum of 5 years gained within the EU, which is mandatory given the EU specific nature of this regulation. Experience within the Dutch market of 5 years or more is a strong preference.

  • Proven record of engaging directly with data protection authorities on compliance matters

  • Experience handling data protection and privacy issues for a regulated entity, ideally in tech or ecommerce

  • Strong knowledge of and interest in emerging technologies and their social and economic impact, including customer facing ecommerce

  • Proven ability to analyze complex legal, regulatory and business issues and give sound advice under time pressure

  • Experience managing multiple compliance projects, frameworks or teams, including internal and external resources and delivering training

  • Knowledge of IT security and data analysis methodologies, with experience working alongside IT Security teams in a data driven business

  • A strategic, open minded and user centered thinker, who communicates proactively, connects the dots across industry and regulatory trends, and stays focused on execution

At Bitvavo, we believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation, foster creativity, and lead to better outcomes. We are committed to building a team that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve and creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Regardless of race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, ability, or any other characteristic. Join us and be part of a team that values and celebrates your unique contributions.

Bitvavo does not accept resumes from staffing, search, or recruitment firms without a signed agreement. If you send us a resume without such an agreement, we may contact the candidate directly without any obligation whatsoever and no fee of any kind will be paid should we hire the candidate.

What We Offer

At Bitvavo, we believe in attracting, motivating and retaining talented people through market-competitive offerings that go beyond compensation alone. To learn more about our total rewards package and the benefits we offer, visit our Life at Bitvavo page.

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom.

We are seeking a Senior Manager Compliance to join our dynamic Compliance Team within our LATAM region. We are a team of risk-minded problem solvers who advise regional business on the company's regulatory obligations and enterprise risk. The successful candidate will have extensive knowledge and experience in KYC/KYB, CDD/EDD, AML/FT and Sanctions' regulations, particularly within the LATAM crypto markets.

descriptions.job-1rp32pe:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

About the Team

The Security team is responsible for and committed to securing all things at TRM. From our customers to our code, and everything in between, the security team is involved in all aspects of the business. We are looking for an Application Security Engineer to build mission-critical infrastructure that ensures the highest levels of availability, performance, and application security at TRM for products as built and deployed. From designing the technical strategy to company-wide best practices and implementation, you’ll work closely with engineering and engineering leadership to ensure TRM’s products are safe and secure.

The impact you will have here:

  • Lead application security reviews and threat modeling, including secure code review, architectural design, and testing

  • Develop automated testing and mature our Secure SDLC

  • Own and perform application security vulnerability management

  • Coordinate penetration testing engagements

  • Support software engineers and product teams by developing application security best practices

  • Develop and maintain the bug bounty program

  • Bootstrap platform security initiatives that help protect TRM data

  • Inspire a culture of security across the engineering organization by fostering security champions within engineering teams and coordinating secure code training.

What we’re looking for:

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in Software Development and testing.

  • BS (or equivalent) in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field.

  • Proficiency in software development languages: Python, NodeJS, React

  • Strong understanding of encryption, authentication, and authorization protocols

  • Deep experience with common software flaws (e.g., OWASP and CWE), testing methodologies , and using common security tooling for testing.

  • Professional experience with open source, commercial, or native security solutions for cloud providers such as GCP and AWS. Experience with modern secure software development lifecycles, threat modeling, and best practices.

  • Experience with conducting efficient and comprehensive code security reviews on a daily or weekly basis

  • Experience triaging and remediating vulnerabilities in software packages or libraries

  • Experience with Software Security tools such as Github advanced security or other SAST, DAST, and SCA tools

  • Experience with Web application testing frameworks such as BurpSuite, OWASP ZAP, etc.

  • Experience with Threat modeling tools such as OWASP Threat Dragon, etc.

  • Experience working in a previous agile-based software development role required

  • Experience Red Teaming or penetration testing applications and infrastructure

  • Professional experience with cloud providers (e.g., GCP and AWS), modern secure software development lifecycles, and best practices.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Security certifications such as OSCP, CEH, GWAPT are a plus.

  • Familiarity with security frameworks (e.g., NIST SP 800-171 SSDF) is a plus

About the Team:

  • The culture of our team is built on mutual respect, where everyone's opinion is valued and heard.

  • We prioritize flexibility and efficiency, always seeking smarter ways to work without compromising quality.

  • Transparency is at the heart of how we operate, both within the team and with the business, as we focus on clearly communicating and addressing cyber risks.

  • Our collaborative approach ensures that we not only mitigate these risks but also align our efforts with business goals to protect and drive success.

Team’s Time Zones:

  • Eastern Standard Time (EST - GMT-4)

  • Pacific Standard Time (PST - GMT-7)

  • Central European Summer Time (CET - GMT+2)

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Prioritize Rapid Threat Assessments: Efficiently perform security risk assessments and triage vulnerabilities based on immediate risk to the business, focusing on the most critical issues with minimal delays.

  • Integrate Security Early in Development: Embed security testing and reviews within our Product Shipping Framework and CI/CD pipelines to ensure that security is automated and runs parallel to the fast-paced development cycle, preventing bottlenecks.

  • Proactively Educate Developers: Conduct just-in-time security training for developers and engineers, offering real-time advice and code reviews to help them produce secure code without interrupting their workflow.

  • Optimize Tools for Speed: Leverage lightweight and efficient security tools that can be quickly integrated into development environments without slowing down deployments, ensuring continuous and secure product iterations.

Work Week Travel: This role requires participation in in-person R&D work weeks, typically 1–2 times per quarter, at a TRM hub or other designated location. Work weeks may be scheduled with as little as 14 days’ notice, and some roles may require additional travel based on team and cross-functional needs. TRM coordinates and covers approved travel, lodging, and workspace. Accommodations are available for legitimate caregiving, health, immigration, and similar constraints.

U.S. Citizenship Required: This role requires U.S. citizenship due to the nature of the work and applicable customer and government requirements.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.
